svg.title: Square configuration with 23 points
svg.desc: Square configuration with 23 points. Only 39 triangles lie within relative 1/1000000000 of the exact normalised minimum 0.00964331980900248200477788011085; all other triangles are omitted. Exact minima use the orange, heavier style and near-minima use the blue, lighter style. Hover a triangle to isolate it, click to keep it selected, shift-click to filter its congruence class, or select a point to show only limiting triangles containing that point.
